MENU_DESC: A cozy camp, a giant fire and a very questionable hunting trip. Host a game for up to three friends.
MINIMAP_CLOSE_HINT: [ M ] or [ ESC ]  close the map
CONTROLS: WASD move · SHIFT sprint · SPACE jump · RMB aim · LMB fire · R reload · E interact · B bag · ESC menu · T rally point · E by a fallen animal: manual skinning
WEAPONS_DESC: Pick a weapon. Inspect it, buy it, then make it ridiculous.
BAGS_DESC: More space, longer hunts. Browse your next backpack.
SELL_DESC: Your loot, your money. Sell the contents of your backpack.
INVENTORY_DESC: Visit the loot exchange to sell your catch.
EMPTY_BAG:
Empty backpack.

Collect loot and bring it back to camp.
FULL_BAG: Backpack full! Sell your loot or buy a bigger bag.
BAG_OWNED: You already have a bag this size or bigger.
NOTHING_TO_SELL: Your bag is empty. Bring loot from a hunt.
rusty_pistol_desc: A compact starter pistol with single-shot fire. 6 damage / 0.65 s.
old_rifle_desc: A semiautomatic SCAR-L variant with iron sights. Slow and precise: 12 damage / 1.2 s.
double_barrel_desc: A compact Maverick 88 variant. Six pellets, best up close: 18 total damage / 1.8 s.
expedition: Choose a map at the campfire
DEER_DOWN: Deer down! Press E near the pelt to collect it.
TRAINING_DESC:
Deer nearby · aim + fire
Collect pelt with E · sell at camp
NET_FAILED: Connection failed. Check IP and UDP port.
NET_LOST: Host disconnected. Back in a solo camp.
NET_FULL: This camp already has four hunters.
NET_NOTE: Direct IP · host + 3 friends · Steam integration later
DRIVING: WASD drive · SPACE brake · E exit when stopped · V recover if overturned · ESC menu
STOP_TO_EXIT: Stop the jeep before getting out.
TRUNK_DESC: Shared storage. Each item keeps its owner.
TRUNK_FULL: Trunk full. Your remaining loot stays in your backpack.
PARK_TO_SELL: Park the jeep near this stall to sell trunk loot.
NETWORK_NOTE: Direct IP · host + 3 friends · Steam integration later
ROTATE_HINT: DRAG TO ROTATE  ·  SCROLL TO ZOOM
BAG_CAROUSEL_DESC: Carry up to {n} loot slots. Every animal you bring home funds the next upgrade.
WEAPON_LOCKED: Buy this weapon before equipping it.
scrap_blaster_desc: A fictional Maverick 88 variant with a scrap-metal finish. Eight pellets for close-range targets.
beehive_desc: An automatic UZI in the Beehive variant. Hold the trigger for a fast swarm of bullets.
thunder_tube_desc: A fictional electromagnetic variant with the M72 LAW silhouette. Light, noise and 180 damage / 1.8 s.
sniper_rifle_desc: A G36 K marksman variant with a 4x scope in-game. Powerful single shots: 70 damage / 1.5 s.
revolver_desc: A precision pistol with six rounds per reload in-game. 32 damage / 0.5 s.
ak_rifle_desc: An automatic SCAR-L rifle with a 30-round magazine. High fire rate, 15 damage per bullet.
railgun_desc: A fictional G36 K energy variant with a tight scope. A devastating single shot: 95 damage / 1.75 s.
raygun_desc: A fictional energy variant with the Baretta 93R silhouette. Fast shots: 17 damage / 0.22 s.
chain_smg_desc: An automatic MG42. Hold the trigger: 60 rounds per reload and an extreme fire rate in-game.
nova_shotgun_desc: Ten pellets in a wide fan. Powerful up close, with reduced accuracy at range.
WAIT_HOST: Waiting for the host to start
LOBBY_HOST_HINT: E near the campfire → Choose a map and start the expedition
LOBBY_DESC: Prepare in camp. The host starts a separate forest world after everyone loads.
LOADING_WAIT: Map ready. Waiting for the team…
LOADING_TIP: Your weapons, backpack and owned loot travel with you. The jeep spawns beside the group.
LOADING_FAILED: Map loading failed. Returning to camp.
WAIT_CONNECTIONS: Wait for the hunters who are still connecting.
JEEP_RECOVERY_DENIED: Recover an overturned jeep when it is stopped and you are nearby.
MAP_SUBTITLE: One campfire. One crew. The next hunt.
MAP_FOREST_DESC: A vast forest, clearings and increasingly powerful prey. Your jeep arrives beside the crew.
MAP_ANIMALS:
Rabbit · Deer · Boar · Wolf · Bear
1–4 hunters · 1.2 × 1.2 km
MAP_HOST_HINT: You are the host. The crew departs after everyone has loaded the map.
MAP_CLIENT_HINT: The host chooses and starts the expedition for the whole crew.
MAP_AT_FIRE: Approach the campfire to start the expedition.
DOWNED_HELP: You are downed. A teammate must hold E beside you for 3 seconds.
MAP_SWAMP_DESC: A misty wetland with shallow pools, reeds and abandoned timber paths. Stay together: the water hides hungry predators.
MAP_SWAMP_ANIMALS:
Frog → Turtle → Snake → Crocodile → Ancient crocodile
Better loot · Tougher wildlife · Mud reduces speed and tire grip
HARVEST_BUSY: Another hunter is already working on this animal.
HARVEST_CANCELLED: Recovery cancelled. You can continue where you left off.
HARVEST_CONTROLS: Mouse: move the knife · Click: grab / release the hide · E / Esc / WASD: give up
HARVEST_DONE_TIP: Quality stays with the item during transport and sale. Continue hunting.
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_BOING: BOING · Not enough, the hide snapped back
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_CHOMP: CHOMP · The jaws caught the knife
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_CLEAN: SPOTLESS · All the fat, in time
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_CRACK: CRACK · Go over it once more
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_CUT: GOOD · Hit the golden centre for perfect
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_FAT_LEFT: TOO LATE · The fat set on the hide
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_FLOP_PERFECT: PERFECT FLOP · Off in one piece
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_FUMBLE: Missed · Click right on the ring
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_GRAB: GOT IT · Now stretch along the arrow
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_OVERPULL: TOO HARD · Off, but torn at the edges
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_PERFECT: PERFECT · Clean cut through the centre
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_RIP: RIP · You stretched it until it split
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_SCRAPED: CLEAN · Another blob of fat gone
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_SNAG: TOO SLOW · The knife snagged — make a short, fast flick
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_SPASM: SPASM · You cut while the body was kicking
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_SPLAT: SPLAT · You burst a tick on the fur
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_STING: OUCH · A bee stung you and the knife jumped
HARVEST_FEEDBACK_WRONG_WAY: WRONG WAY · Cut the way the arrow points
HARVEST_HINT_GRAB: Click the ring to grab the hide
HARVEST_HINT_JAW: JAWS OPENING · Get out of the red zone!
HARVEST_HINT_PULL: Stretch… and click in the green!
HARVEST_HINT_SLASH_DIR: Flick across the seams, the way the arrow points!
HARVEST_INVALID: Move closer to the fallen animal to recover it.
HARVEST_QUIRK_BEES: Bees in the honey-matted fur — dodge them
HARVEST_QUIRK_CHOMP: Bite reflex — get out of the jaws in time
HARVEST_QUIRK_SHELL: Shell — every seam takes two cuts
HARVEST_QUIRK_SLIPPERY: Slippery — the hide slides under the knife
HARVEST_QUIRK_THICK: Thick hide — seams take two cuts
HARVEST_QUIRK_TICKS: Ticks on the fur — don't cut them
HARVEST_TIP: Nothing to hold: the mouse moves the knife and speed is everything.
HARVEST_TIP_0: FLICK the knife across every stitched seam like a sword swipe. The golden centre is PERFECT. Moved slowly, the knife only hovers.
HARVEST_TIP_1: Scrub fast, back and forth, over the fat blobs until they vanish. They set when the timer runs out.
HARVEST_TIP_2: Click the ring to grab the hide, stretch it along the arrow and click again inside the green. Too little = BOING, too much = RIP.
HARVEST_UNAVAILABLE: This animal cannot be recovered now. Move closer and check whether another hunter is working.
